counter_bounds.ownership: Object identity, not diagnostic number; document attempt per document owner, canvas generation per Surface, close attempt per editor controller.

document.promotion: Only live-attempt latest snapshots retained; finished removed; suspended successor promoted immediately.

canvas.selection: Exact currently awaited aggregate hook, including detached retained hooks; failed observation retained; oldest retained hook observation when aggregate idle. Observer exception returns null without changing retirement.
canvas.thread_visibility: LibraryCallbackEntered recorded atomically before posting Main; callback token identity cannot overwrite a successor generation.
canvas.pending_release: Project retirement reuses an existing pending release generation/reason; no fabricated second release observation.

privacy: Counters and fixed enum names only; no source/project/device IDs, paths, payloads or exception text.
local_parser_compatibility: Full schema and one-line reporter handoff supplied to parent/local; acknowledgement and local instrumentation/parser integration remain pending. Device replay must capture all 12 fields.
